gaps.detail: AC-2 says an empty TASKLIST_TODAY falls back to the clock, and no test in tests/test_stats.py sets TASKLIST_TODAY to the empty string. Add a test that sets it to '' and checks that stats exits 0 and prints six lines. The fixture sets the variable to a valid date, so the empty-value path through cli.today() is never run for stats.

AC-4 and AC-6 together say that under --tag the tags of done tasks are checked and the open tasks' due and priority are still checked. The tests check the error for a done task with bad tags under --tag (test_ac6_done_task_checks). No test checks that --tag NAME still reports a bad due date or priority on an open task that does not carry NAME. Add one, so the validation is not narrowed to the filtered tasks.
